notes: Brake/fuel line clip to frame bolt, 1969-82. One other vendor listing (seen in search summary) described 5/16-24 x 1/2; Zip and AMK agree on 5/16-18 x 9/16. Downgraded in review: one vendor lists 5/16-24 x 1/2 (thread pitch disagrees); not resolved by majority. Second pass: 5/16-24 source is Corvette Pacifica's 56-82 set (its text also mentions 1963-67 spare tire bolts, looks copy-pasted); the same vendor's 69-82 14-piece kit says 5/16-18. Now 3 sources for 5/16-18 vs 1 for 5/16-24; left as conflict for reviewer.
